event_summary.short: Three women shoplifted from Ulta Beauty in Vernon Hills, Illinois, fled in a gray Kia Optima, crashed, and were arrested. One suspect, Brittany Christmas, was seriously injured. Jariah Terrell was convicted of retail theft, aggravated fleeing, and DUI; Kaniyah Williams and Brittany Christmas were convicted of retail theft.
